name: openspec_generate_artifact
description: One fan-out unit of openspec_plan: fetch one OpenSpec artifact's generation instructions (typed CLI task, not agent judgment) and run a coding_agent to write that artifact's content, addressing prior review feedback.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repo containing the OpenSpec change; used both to fetch generation instructions and as the coding_agent's worktreePath.

changeName.description: OpenSpec change id the artifact belongs to.

artifact.description: Artifact id to generate (e.g. proposal, design, specs, tasks).

goal.description: Change goal/description text embedded verbatim into the generation prompt; optional, prompt omits it when blank.

feedback.description: Prior review feedback text to append to the prompt so the rewrite addresses it; blank means no prior feedback.

model.description: Compatibility override: explicit model id for the coding agent session, backend inferred from the id.

maxTurns.description: Cap on coding agent turns for this artifact-writing session.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Cap on USD spend for the coding agent session.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select when resolving models for this run.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to the repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role overrides merged on top of the selected profile's roles.

artifact.description: Artifact id that was generated, passed through from the workflow input.

filesChanged.description: Repository-relative paths the coding agent changed while writing this artifact.

costUsd.description: Total USD cost of the coding agent session that wrote this artifact.

tokenUsed.description: Total tokens consumed by the coding agent session.

agent.description: Backend that ran the writing session: claude, codex, or gemini.

sessionId.description: Backend session id for the writing session, usable as resumeSessionId; empty string if unavailable.

result.description: The coding agent's final text response, truncated to 2000 characters.
